svg.title: Keep the isolated points
svg.desc: Complete seven-form atlas at threshold 1/8 · folded frame 0 ≤ x ≤ 1/2 The full atlas preserves information that a positive-volume or top-cap picture would omit. A singleton has zero duration or volume and can still contain an exact safe witness when its orbit is compatible. All ten completed cells are shown independently of the construction stage. A geometric point alone is not a physical time.

g.text: TEN CLOSED CELLS · C1 HIGHLIGHTED · VERTICAL SCALE ×2
C0, C3 and C5 are closed singleton cells, shown as hollow rings. C7 has six vertices; each other
nonsingleton cell is a tetrahedron. Counts are per-cell occurrences, not counts of distinct
